blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — A 56-year-old farmer was shot dead by his neighbor with an improvised shotgun following an alleged altercation over a goat that had grazed on the victim’s crops in Barangay Quezon, Bilar, Bohol, on Tuesday afternoon. The shooting occurred shortly after 5 p.m., according to the initial investigation by the police. Investigators said the confrontation reportedly started when a goat strayed into a nearby farm and ate some crops, prompting an argument between the farmer and the goat owner’s wife.
